Hero.headline: Hamza Alhaj builds software that doesn't lose things.
Hero.body: Invoices, medicine packs, birthday flowers. I'm a full-stack developer, and each line on this map is a system I worked on. Every stop is a real step in it, including the places it can go wrong.
Hero.mapLabel: A transit map of seven software projects. Each line is a project and each stop a step in its workflow. The projects are listed after the map.

zatca.statement: A lost invoice is a compliance problem, not just a bug.
zatca.lead: Every sale a Saudi retailer finalizes has to become a signed, compliant e-invoice, and simplified invoices must reach ZATCA within 24 hours.
zatca.story: This integration turns finalized Retail Pro documents into durable workflows. Each step is separate, so a failure can be retried or reconciled instead of lost, and stores can keep signing invoices while offline.

highlights.label: Invoice workflows
highlights.detail: Ingestion, normalization, XML generation, signing, submission

highlights.label: Background processing
highlights.detail: Queue workers, with the database as the source of truth

highlights.label: Offline handling
highlights.detail: Edge agent with local signing, QR codes and a durable outbox

highlights.label: Reconciliation
highlights.detail: Ordered reporting with a recorded history of every attempt

zatca.note: Private project, shown with sample data

branches.offline: The store signs locally, adds the QR code and holds the invoice in a durable outbox.
branches.retry: A failed submission is retried or reconciled, and every attempt is recorded.

sfda.statement: When the answer is unclear, don't report twice.
sfda.lead: Saudi Arabia's SFDA tracks medicine packs individually, from warehouse to pharmacy to patient. Staff can't stop serving customers to report each movement, so this integration works from inside the Retail Pro Prism point of sale.
sfda.story: Receiving, transfers and pharmacy sales are picked up from finalized documents, and a scanner reads each pack's DataMatrix code. When SFDA's response is unclear, the outcome is held as unknown instead of being retried blindly, so a pack isn't reported twice.

highlights.label: Service development
highlights.detail: .NET Windows service with local SQLite persistence

highlights.label: POS integration
highlights.detail: Prism WebClient plugin for transactions and stock matching

highlights.label: Scanning
highlights.detail: GS1 DataMatrix item scanner for tracked medicines

highlights.label: Reliable delivery
highlights.detail: Durable dispatch, safe retries and explicit unknown outcomes

sfda.note: Private project, shown with sample data

branches.unknown: An unclear SFDA response stops here as an explicit unknown. It isn't retried blindly.

shots: SFDA RSD transactions inside the Prism plugin

raneem.statement: Flowers for a birthday only count if they arrive on the right day.
raneem.lead: Raneem Gifts carries that promise from choosing a gift and delivery shift through preparation, quality checks and dispatch, to a handover confirmed with a photo and a one-time code.
raneem.story: One platform is designed around customers, personal shoppers, drivers and twelve permission-scoped staff roles, in both Arabic and English, so everyone works from the same order.

strata.statement: 2.1 million matches from 48,000 players, turned into a league.
strata.lead: Strata is the competitive home of the GameReplays.org community for Command & Conquer: Generals, with ladders, player profiles, match history and balance analytics in one place.
strata.story: A constant stream of game results becomes ratings, league standings and faction win rates. In October 2026, 954 people were on the site at the same time.

highlights.detail: Overall and seasonal ladders with ratings and league results

highlights.label: Data pipeline
highlights.detail: Scheduled ingestion and queue workers for match history

highlights.label: Analytics

strata.note: Live site, built with the GameReplays team

aleef.statement: Everything a pet needs, booked in one place.
aleef.lead: Owners book grooming and clinic visits at their nearest branch, join behavior courses, shop services and find pets to adopt, all in Arabic and on any device.
aleef.story: Behind that simple flow is a custom reservation system that handles availability across branches and service types. The platform reports more than 10,000 completed sessions and 5,000 happy pets, supported by over 50 expert trainers.

highlights.label: Booking
highlights.detail: Service, branch and time selection across every location

highlights.label: Services

occasion.statement: A storefront as considered as the gifts it sells.
occasion.lead: Occasion is a premium gifting store for chocolates, flowers and perfumes.
occasion.story: Built headless on nopCommerce, it renders catalog pages on the server for speed and search visibility, and covers the complete journey from browsing to a placed order, including personalized gift cards, in Arabic and English.

highlights.label: Authentication
highlights.detail: Phone OTP sign-in with tokens kept in httpOnly cookies

highlights.label: Checkout
highlights.detail: Guest cart, shipping, payment and order placement

highlights.label: Localization

highlights.label: API contracts
highlights.detail: Typed clients generated from the OpenAPI specification

rtm.statement: Accounting workflows, on the open-source edition.
rtm.lead: RTM Accounting brings financial reports, bank matching, fixed assets, deferrals, budgets and receivables follow-up to Odoo 19 Community as independent modules.
rtm.story: A connected workspace ties the work together, so a team can follow a purchase through stock, sale, invoice and bank match, with live figures on one overview.

highlights.label: Business modules
highlights.detail: Accounting addon and a connected app workspace

highlights.label: Reporting
highlights.detail: Financial statements and ledgers, exported to XLSX and PDF

items.title: Every step is its own stop.
items.body: Separate steps mean a failure can be retried or reconciled at the point it happened, and nothing upstream is lost.

items.title: Unknown is a valid answer.
items.body: If a system can't tell whether something worked, it should say so, not guess and report the same pack twice.

items.title: The journey ends with proof.
items.body: An order isn't done when it leaves the shop. It's done when a photo and a one-time code confirm the handover.

items.title: Arabic isn't a translation.
items.body: Right-to-left Arabic and left-to-right English come from one component system, in products people use today.
